protocol.user_goal: Top5% of actual competition entries; no leaderboard distribution is available so no percentile claim is supported
protocol.primary_selection: Official possession-spell F1, mean over four fixed external conditions
protocol.history: Adaptive development on two extensively reused Bundesliga matches.028/029 configured before rank-goal clarification. This030 policy is written before inspecting their outcome reports.
protocol.tradeoff: False-positive counts are reported, not a hard veto by themselves, because official spellF1 already scores matched/missed/spurious possession objects. This explicitly supersedes the earlier no-FP-increase deployment policy for rank-first selection.
protocol.eligibility: Mean spellF1>019; every prior condition/fold spellF1 loss<=.01; tracker-noise fold no decline; every per-state deadF1 decline<=.005. Tie within1e-6: higher macroF1, then fewer false positives.
protocol.freeze_policy: Select and hash one complete pipeline on old observation draws before any new-draw evaluation; no changes or alternative re-selection after that audit.
protocol.audit_policy: Evaluate019 and frozen selected candidate only. Diagnostic new missingness realisations on the same games, not a new-match test. If meanF1 does not improve, report failure and retain019 as predefined fallback; do not select a runner-up using audit results.

limitations: Ranking proxy uses two heavily reused provider-labelled matches; competitors/private scores unknown.
New-draw audit changes missingness only and is not independent-match testing.
False-positive counts may rise under the clarified ranking-first policy; full trade-off is reported.
Synthetic quality gate may not recognise actual supplied tracking failures.
No supplied-game labels, video, tracking or public score enter training/selection.
